zh: 把进程分成两组，相当于选出分给第一台服务器的子集，其和为 x，差值就是 |S−2x|（S 为总和）。所以关键是知道哪些子集和可以达到。
所有负载绝对值之和不超过 20 万，可以用位集合记录可达子集和；有负数时把位集合的下标整体偏移，维护表示区间的下界 low。由于子集与补集对称，只需在不超过 ⌊S/2⌋ 的可达和里取最大的。
位集合初始只有 0；对每个负载 v：位集合 |= 位集合 << |v|，若 v<0 再令 low+=v（下标 i 表示和 i+low）；最后令 limit=⌊S/2⌋−low（负数向下取整），找下标不超过 limit 的最高置位 i，chosen=i+low，输出 |S−2×chosen|。
en: Splitting the processes into two groups is choosing the subset for the first server; if its sum is x, the difference is |S - 2x| where S is the total. So the key is knowing which subset sums are reachable.

The sum of absolute loads is at most 200000, so reachable subset sums fit in a bitset; negative loads shift the indices, so keep a lower bound low of the represented range. Because a subset and its complement are symmetric, take the largest reachable sum that is at most floor(S/2).

Start the bitset with only 0; for each load v: bitset |= bitset << |v|, and if v < 0 also add v to low (index i means sum i + low); finally let limit = floor(S/2) - low (rounding down for negatives), find the highest set index i <= limit, set chosen = i + low and print |S - 2 * chosen|.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the reachable subset sums in an integer bitset; when a load is negative, shift the lower bound of the represented range accordingly. Finally find the largest reachable sum not exceeding half of the total.

## Correctness

When a load is added, every subset either skips it or takes it, and the union of the shifted sets fully represents the new subset sums. Any subset sum x assigned to the first server gives the difference |S - 2x|. Complementary subsets guarantee that the optimum can be taken with x <= floor(S/2), and on that side a larger x is better.

## Complexity

Let A be the total of absolute values. Time is about O(nA/w + A/w) and space O(A/w), where w is the machine word width used inside the big integer.
